title: TITLE: THE NAME BOX SHOWS LOWER CASE
why: His order 2026-10-18: all text shown to the player is lower case. The title name box showed PILLAGER in capitals (text-transform none). The saved name is unchanged, only how it is drawn.
now: The name box on the title is lower case.

edits.replacement: #root #title #slotpanel #pnamein{ text-transform:lowercase; }   /* v28.xx (cw-title-name), his order 2026-10-18: "change all text shown to player to lowercase only"; the critic on 01 saw PILLAGER in capitals in the name box. */
